groups.name: iqscaffold
groups.description: IQ Scaffold custom configuration properties for the Contact Service.

groups.name: iqscaffold.i18n
groups.description: Internationalization configuration for the Contact Service.

groups.name: iqscaffold.liquibase
groups.description: Liquibase configuration for multi-tenant schema management.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm
groups.description: CRM-specific configuration properties for contact and company management.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm.security
groups.description: Security configuration for the Contact Service.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm.security.jwt
groups.description: JWT configuration for authentication and authorization.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact
groups.description: Contact management configuration including lead scoring and activity tracking.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm.company
groups.description: Company management configuration including hierarchy and scoring features.

groups.name: iqscaffold.crm.activity
groups.description: Activity tracking and logging configuration for CRM interactions.

properties.name: iqscaffold.tenant-id-header
properties.description: HTTP header name used to identify the tenant in multi-tenant requests.

properties.name: iqscaffold.user-service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the User Service for inter-service communication.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.supported-locales
properties.description: List of supported locale codes for internationalization (e.g., en, es, fr).

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.default-locale
properties.description: Default locale to use when no locale is specified or the requested locale is not supported.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.message-basename
properties.description: Base name for message resource bundles (e.g., i18n/messages).

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.message-cache-duration
properties.description: Duration to cache message resources. Use ISO-8601 duration format (e.g., PT1H for 1 hour).

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.fallback-to-system-locale
properties.description: Whether to fall back to the system locale if the requested locale is not found.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.use-code-as-default-message
properties.description: Whether to use the message code as the default message if no message is found.

properties.name: iqscaffold.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Path to the Liquibase changelog file for system-level database migrations.

properties.name: iqscaffold.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Path to the Liquibase changelog file for tenant-specific database migrations.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.security.jwt.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: URI to fetch the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) for JWT token validation.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.security.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Expected issuer claim value in JWT tokens for validation.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact.enable-lead-scoring
properties.description: Enable lead scoring functionality for contacts to prioritize sales efforts.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact.enable-activity-tracking
properties.description: Enable tracking of all activities and interactions with contacts.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact.enable-email-integration
properties.description: Enable email integration for sending and tracking emails with contacts.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact.default-lead-score
properties.description: Default lead score assigned to new contacts when lead scoring is enabled.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.contact.max-lead-score
properties.description: Maximum possible lead score a contact can achieve.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.company.enable-company-hierarchy
properties.description: Enable company hierarchy management for parent-subsidiary relationships.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.company.enable-company-scoring
properties.description: Enable scoring functionality for companies to prioritize business opportunities.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.activity.enable-auto-logging
properties.description: Enable automatic logging of activities such as emails, calls, and meetings.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.activity.retention-days
properties.description: Number of days to retain activity records before archival or deletion.

properties.name: iqscaffold.crm.activity.max-activities-per-contact
properties.description: Maximum number of activities that can be associated with a single contact.

values.description: Extended 0-1000 scoring scale for granular scoring
Low limit - suitable for small teams
Medium limit - balanced for most use cases
High limit - for high-volume sales teams
Unlimited - no limit on activities (use with caution)
